items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Don Costa got the idea we should try something for United Artists, which we hadn't done, but we did it.

ctx.x: Don Costa got the idea we should try something for United Artists, which we hadn't done, but we did it. But that's the last, from then on it was nothing.
If they did sell anything, they didn't let us know. I've never seen a statement from them.
